claim: Patchline ships a proof-carrying-code format so every emitted verdict travels with a checkable proof witness. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the proof witness claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make proof-carrying-verdict-gate`.
